context_quotes: (a) On an individual's person or accessible property—prohibitions. Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property—

(2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter.
(3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

(3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

scope_quotes: (c) In checked baggage. A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter:
scope_text: For a passenger transporting or offering for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23, unless all specified conditions (i) through (iv) are met.
choice_text: All four conditions must be satisfied: declaration to the aircraft operator orally or in writing before checking baggage that the bag contains an unloaded firearm; the firearm is unloaded; the firearm is in a hard-sided container; and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.
summary: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unloaded firearm(s) unless all of the following conditions are met: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
quote:
(c) In checked baggage. A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter:

(1) Any loaded firearm(s).

(2) Any unloaded firearm(s) unless—

(i) The passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded;

(ii) The firearm is unloaded;

(iii) The firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and

(iv) The container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.

scope_text: For a passenger, in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
summary: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.
quote:
(c) In checked baggage. A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter:

(1) Any loaded firearm(s).

(2) Any unloaded firearm(s) unless—

(i) The passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded;

(ii) The firearm is unloaded;

(iii) The firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and

(iv) The container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.

(3) Any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.
logic_text: (c) In checked baggage. A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter:

scope_text: Carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
context_quotes: (c) In checked baggage. A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter:
summary: Section 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm, while Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
quote: (d) Ammunition. This section does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm. Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
